overview: Hotel Revenue Rate Fence Optimisation addresses resource allocation is planned in silos, producing avoidable delays and occasionally infeasible instructions in hospitality and tourism operations. The first proof of value uses booking pace, competitor rates and room availability. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is room revenue per available room, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: booking pace, competitor rates and room availability; define room revenue per available room and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Hotel GM / Hospitality Revenue Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including replay disruption and edge cases with hard constraints enforced.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for room revenue per available room
